description: Add a domains table as the SMTP acceptance allowlist. Domain check happens at RCPT TO before DATA — unknown domains get 550 Relay denied immediately, before Sieve runs. Domains table is not a routing table (Sieve handles routing) but serves three purposes: (1) SMTP relay denial, (2) TLS cert provisioning anchor (Let's Encrypt per-domain), (3) per-domain DKIM key association. Schema: domains(domain PK, description, created_at). Admin API: CRUD on domains table. No config-file domain list — fully dynamic in SQLite, hot.
title: design: domain registry and SMTP acceptance
